title: MNCS Aggregate Result
description: Composed verdict over independent check-results. Dominance is FAIL > UNKNOWN > PASS over required checks. Optional UNKNOWN stays visible in unresolved and never silently decides the boundary. checks[] may carry optional digest/path for provenance traversal (mncs-actions carries, owners define meaning).

digest.description: SHA-256 of the exact consumed check-result bytes (bare hex64 or sha256:-prefixed). Optional; when present it must be well-formed. mncs-actions carries it; the owning provider defines its meaning.

path.description: Safe relative path of the consumed check-result under the declared working directory (no absolute paths, no .. traversal, no backslashes). Optional; when present it must be safe. Executable validation in lib/mncs_actions.py is authoritative for edge cases.
